# Authored asset fixtures

`safe-shapes.svg` is original synthetic geometry authored for F05, licensed
under the [foundation fixture MIT license](../foundation/LICENSE.txt). It
contains no product design, photograph, app screenshot, user file or remote
reference. Hostile inputs and tiny PNGs are generated in co-located asset tests.

Tests read the existing foundation stripe PNG, ABeeZee Regular font and
unmodified OFL notice in place. No foundation bytes or manifests are changed.
The font is only the pinned normal 400 face, not inferred bold or italic.
